label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Dear neighbors,

I’m writing about a note that appeared in the lobby this week concerning a drone seen near the building. I live in 5A and want to explain what I was doing, apologize for the worry, and offer a way to verify it.

On Saturday, October 31, around 4 p.m., I flew a new drone—a Halvard Mini 4—from the roof deck for about 11 minutes. I’m a wedding photographer and was testing the camera and controls before a vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera was pointed west toward the river and Fremont Bridge the entire time. It was not pointed at any windows, and I was not filming or observing residents.

I understand how it looked. A drone hovering over the courtyard is strange and unsettling if you don’t know what’s going on, and I’m sorry people were worried. That wasn’t my intention.

I also want to say that the note calling me a creep and including my unit number was upsetting. It felt like being publicly singled out. I’m not writing to start a fight; I’m asking that if anyone has a concern about me or something I’m doing, please come talk to me directly next time.

I’m happy to show the full, unedited clip to any resident who wants to see it. Knock on 5A or email jess.okafor@mailbox.example.

Our HOA rules don’t currently address drones. I’ve asked the board to add this to the November 19 meeting agenda (7 p.m., community room), and I won’t fly from the roof again until the board decides on a rule.

Thanks for reading.

Jess Okafor  
Unit 5A
